mode: 根据用户两张新参考照片重新制作完整人物
prompt: Create a NEW full-body Huang Rong 黄蓉 character portrait based primarily on the TWO USER-SUPPLIED Barbara Yung reference photographs. IMAGE 1 is the PRIMARY facial and hair identity reference. IMAGE 2 confirms the same woman's real facial structure, fringe, side locks and head proportions. IMAGE 3 is garment construction reference only. Highest priority is a recognizable likeness to IMAGE 1, not an idealized generic fantasy face. Faithfully reproduce its specific face width-to-height ratio, cheeks and jaw contour, compact chin, natural distance between eyes, rounded almond upper eyelids, lower eyelids, brow placement, small nose shape, lip contour and relaxed expression. Keep full natural cheeks and individual asymmetries. Do not give her a long pointed V chin, fox-eye lift, huge doll eyes or modern cosmetic facial reshaping. A calm subtle closed-mouth smile with lively intelligent eyes, the gentle curious look of IMAGE 1. Match its wispy forehead fringe, swept-up black crown, small looped/coiled buns with discreet pink floral and gold ornaments, TWO long straight side locks ending over chest; no giant decorative bow shapes. Petite but clearly ADULT woman age22 in this game, normal balanced human proportions about seven heads tall. A relaxed coherent whole-body standing posture: head/neck/shoulders/pelvis naturally connected, shoulders soft with slight asymmetry, tiny natural head tilt, eyes comfortably toward viewer, both arms relaxed while loosely holding a slim green bamboo flute across low waist with two hands, realistic fingers and wrists. No mannequin fashion pose, no forced hip twist, no stiff hands on hip. Clothing from IMAGE 3: pink floral translucent short-sleeve open-front outer tunic, ivory-white standing-collar inner blouse and loose sleeves, broad flat gold waist belt, gold cuff bands, ankle-length ivory skirt with pink panels, complete small embroidered flats visible. No blue floral vest, no floor-length train. Render as a high-quality realistic hand-painted Chinese game character illustration, restrained soft colored-pencil/watercolor finish across skin, hair and fabric; consistent lighting and material detail, not photo face pasted onto a cartoon body. Full figure from hair ornaments through soles, centered with modest padding. TRUE transparent alpha background, character and flute only, no ground plane, background scene, glow, shadows behind silhouette, text, screen UI or watermarks. Do not include black screenshot borders from references.
